messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a quick customer-facing cadence for the partial degradation this morning. Statuspage update + short broadcast + hold on demo webinars. Thought: tiered windows (immediate advisory, follow-up update at +2h, final note once degraded jobs drained).
alex_ops: On it. Agree with tiered windows. Ops can provide root-cause blurb for the +2h update.
ryan_cs: We should flag all inbound trial leads from the last 24h for outreach. I'll queue CS to prioritize enterprise/org tiers.
sam_oncall: Current ETA for full recovery ~3.5h but could slip. I'll update incident channel as we know more. For status copy keep technical detail minimal.
nora_product: Marketing, please avoid promising timelines in the first broadcast. Use something like: "We're experiencing an intermittent degradation impacting model response times for some customers. We're actively investigating and will publish updates."
maya: Good phrasing, thanks Nora. Can legal review the short copy variants? @legal_bot can you sanity-check tone (no liability language)?
legal_bot: quick note: avoid "we'll fix by" or guarantees. "We're investigating" + "we will provide updates" is fine.
maya: Draft 1 for immediate post (for review):

"We are currently experiencing intermittent degradation affecting inference latency for a subset of customers. Our engineers are actively investigating and we've put mitigations in place to reduce impact. We'll post an update within two hours or sooner if there's a material change."

maya: TL;DR block for statuspage: "Degraded inference latency — investigating.
Impact: slower responses for some requests.
Action: engineering investigating; mitigations applied.
Update cadence: 2 hours or sooner."

alex_ops: Suggest adding a "what you can do" line for customers: "If you see errors, retry after 10s; contact support with request IDs." Keep it one sentence.
ryan_cs: For lead routing: I'll add a triage tag to incoming leads, CS will mark enterprise/high-touch and route to AE follow-up within 4 hours of contact. Marketing will pause outbound demo invites for 24h for affected regions.
maya: Webinar hold — please pause any scheduled product webinars in the next 48h or add a hold slide at the start informing attendees of degraded performance; avoid pushing live demos. Who owns attendee comms?
ryan_cs: CS will send a short note to registrants: "We're postponing live demos due to a platform issue; updated schedule to follow." Keep subject line short.
sam_oncall: Ops will publish the +2h update with root cause progress. If recovery happens sooner, we'll push an immediate all-clear.
maya: Timing plan agreed: immediate advisory (this copy), operations update at +2h (technical progress), final resolution/rollback note when resolved. Marketing to draft email + social copy variants (short, long) and hold webinar comms.
nora_product: I'll prepare a short FAQ for support: 3 bullets (what's happening, who is impacted, how to get help).
maya: Thanks team. I'll post the immediate statuspage copy in 5m unless anyone objects. :loudspeaker: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
